$comment: Run-only tsconfig for scripts/ai-flow-eval.ts, used by `tsx` via `--tsconfig`. It resolves the `@/` alias and the `server-only` marker (the same no-op stub Vitest uses) and pins the public example format pack, so the eval never loads a private pack. The root tsconfig.json is not modified and `tsc --noEmit` does not read this file.
